title: Regioselective N‐alkylation for the synthesis of novel aminotriazolophanes
abstract: AbstractRegioselective synthesis of macrocycles, incorporating 3‐oxo‐4‐amino‐1,2,4‐triazole derivatives, has been achieved by reactions involving N‐alkylation, utilizing appropriate 1, ω ‐dihaloalkanes in the presence of metal hydroxide. © 2006 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. Heteroatom Chem 17:329–336, 2006; Published online in Wiley InterScience (www.interscience.wiley.com). DOI 10.1002/hc.20211
